description: We are Win Academy, an education coaching center based in Dadu. We are tackling the Earth System Trend Detective challenge alongside our talented students to represent our institute on a global stage. While our exact project is currently under wraps, our goal is to build a high-impact tech solution for climate data accessibility. We are looking for motivated members with skills in React/Next.js, API integration, UI/UX, or storytelling. Join us to build tech for the real world!
